meaning.en: A placement in a certain rank or class.
meaning.vi: Một vị trí trong một thứ hạng hoặc hạng nhất định.

meaning.en: A specified performance limit, as of capacity, range, or operational capability.

meaning.en: An evaluation of the financial status of a business or person.

meaning.en: A rank, class, or grade; specif., a classification of military or naval personnel according to specialized skills and training.
